qualification_notes: The dynamic-only prototype failed the existing contract for writes while an unrelated non-evictable OVERLAY owns the whole range. Separate bounded noinline stack fallbacks preserve that contract; the prototype was never installed.

Normal checkpoint page and root header storage use disjoint loans of the same 512-byte IO buffer. Page allocation/verification completes before pinning that buffer. The full-pool fallback can consume additional transient stack; frame and actual hardware watermarks are reported, not inferred from BSS savings.
An initial new stress fixture used NUL-filled TEXT rejected by existing validation; it was corrected to ordinary text. Validation was not relaxed.

Initial matrix references predated the standalone build and an F401 constant-pointer warning failed Werror. The final 25-case matrix is bound to the recorded production diff and passed all original source/archive/RAM limits.
Both qualified boards retain their original files, directories, calculator program/registers/stack/IP/current directory and RTC settings. Reserved probe files and APPs were removed.

Ordinary binary MSC uses the unchanged 12288-byte test target; the separate APP/file-service RAM workload uses its existing 11264-byte target on both control and candidate. Firmware stack/guard limits are unchanged.
No physical Mac sleep retest: power/startup are unchanged; ARM reset/suspend/resume tests passed.

After both boards passed and all ports closed, Classic was released to the separately authorized byte-code task with the immutable E52F87BE ELF/BIN recovery pair. Later activity by that task is outside this qualification.
Earlier EP0 host-test/control interruptions are documented in stm32-fixed-ep0-20261015.json; initial local raw artifacts remain available.
